strategy: Cast Blizzard repeatedly as your primary damage source while using Hydra for passive support and Teleport for mobility. Once Static Field unlocks at level 38, the build becomes significantly more powerful and resource-efficient, with Unstable Currents reserved primarily for boss fights.
